# ADO601: constant-condition

A condition is always true or always false.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Conditions |
| **Default severity** | warning |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | each original source file, before template expansion |

## Description

The condition doesn't depend on any variable, parameter or job status, so it always evaluates the same way. An always-false condition disables the element. An always-true condition also runs it after failures and cancellation.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
- script: ./deploy.sh
  condition: or(eq(variables.env, 'prod'), true)
```

Instead:

```yaml
- script: ./deploy.sh
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.env, 'prod'))
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO601: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO601` or `--enable ADO601`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO601
```
